notes: Coordinate 0 decodes per coordinate to the active-member count. The 75 ranking keys select which members are active only jointly with all other keys and the count (random keys, sort and truncate): no per-coordinate discrete meaning, kept continuous.

Section coordinates decode per coordinate to a catalogue index; the twelve circular hollow sections are sorted by outer diameter with non-decreasing wall thickness, so area, inertia and mass are strictly increasing: sorted catalogue sizes, integer. A section coordinate matters only while its member is active.
